description: 505 trace spans (ascending detail capped at 500 with partial=true, descending list capped at 100), 105 encoded searchable logs, 505 grants capped at 500, and four significant digit rounding ties.

postgres: DO $$ DECLARE d date; t text; BEGIN FOR d IN SELECT current_date+i FROM generate_series(-1,2) i LOOP FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY['metrics','spans','logs','resources'] LOOP EXECUTE format('CREATE TABLE analytics_%s_%s PARTITION OF analytics_%s FOR VALUES FROM (%L) TO (%L)',t,to_char(d,'YYYYMMDD'),t,d,d+1); END LOOP; END LOOP; END $$

INSERT INTO analytics_spans SELECT date_trunc('minute',now())-interval '1 minute'-i*interval '1 millisecond',repeat('a',32),lpad(to_hex(i),16,'0'),NULL,'rig','allowed','chat','row-'||i,'ok',i,false FROM generate_series(1,505) i
INSERT INTO analytics_logs SELECT date_trunc('minute',now())-interval '1 minute'-i*interval '1 millisecond','rig','allowed','error','percent%_ + \ '||i,NULL,'[]'::jsonb FROM generate_series(1,105) i
INSERT INTO analytics_grants(user_id,role,granted_by,updated_at) SELECT i::text,'viewer','1',date_trunc('minute',now())-i*interval '1 millisecond' FROM generate_series(10,514) i

INSERT INTO analytics_resources SELECT date_trunc('hour',now())+interval '1 second','host','cpu_pct',1.2345 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('hour',now())+interval '2 seconds','host','mem_used_bytes',12345

allow.reason: Resource fixture is anchored to date_trunc(hour, now()); run-relative normalization varies within an hour. Values and schema remain exact; this fixture tests rounding, not time bucketing.
Seed rows share a minute-aligned clock anchor; independent runs may straddle a minute. Row order and all non-time values remain exact.
Seed grant order uses a minute-aligned anchor and distinct millisecond offsets; only the absolute anchor varies.
